text:
laura: CI microbench failed on PR #6123 — threshold diff for kernel selection, 6% regression :eyes:
aj: looking now, perf artifacts: https://ci.redwood/tests/6123/artifact
aj: quick local run shows throughput drop 6.1% and KV hitrate fell 0.72 -> 0.58
mike: can you paste the minimal repro perf output?
aj: here's the pprof summary:
```
Throughput: base=1200 tok/s -> pr=1128 tok/s (-6.1%)
KV cache hits: base=72% -> pr=58%
Batch size avg: base=8.4 -> pr=6.1
Kernel chosen: fast-attn-v2 -> fallback-attn (cost model flip)
```
sasha: that kernel switch is suspicious — we changed kernel autoselect cost weights in PR 6072 last week
ben: ci-bot ran the bisect job: https://ci.redwood/bisect/6123 shows commit 5c9a8ef (autoselect: adjust cost model weights) as first bad
perf-bot: microbench diff: +6.1% wall per-token, threshold is 3% — failing
laura: ok can somebody try a revert or a targeted patch? this blocks the rollout
aj: quick config test: set runtime.autoselect.enable=false locally -> throughput returns to baseline
mike: I'll open a hotfix PR to revert the weight change and add a unit test to lock the kernel selection for that model/seqLen
sasha: also let's add a perf regression check that asserts KV hitrate doesn't drop >5% for common traces
ben: PR 6130 created, includes revert + threshold update: https://git.redwood/pr/6130 :thumbsup:
mike: landed revert in canary, rolling out now — re-running CI
perf-bot: re-run results: throughput delta -0.8% (within 3% threshold) :party_parrot:
laura: great, thanks all. follow-up: track root cause for why KV hitrate dropped (prefetch alignment?)
aj: filing an issue with heap profile and trace: https://issues.redwood/1234
laura: moving to postmortem / perf checklist. closing thread once canary fully green.
